bug: On a normal canvas, Alt drag with two selected nodes copied only the node under the pointer because startNodeDrag cleared selection immediately after duplicateNodesForAltDrag copied one node.
change: Alt now duplicates the full selected set when the dragged node is selected. Group members are included once, group items map to copied IDs, and Alt+Shift maps internal and external input links to copied targets. The resulting copies move together and one undo removes them.

classicPage.altShiftClick: Using the real page handler with Alt+Shift click, node count 3 to 5 and connection count 2 to 4; copied prompt maps to copied generator, unselected prompt-b remains an external input to copied generator.
classicPage.diskReadback: After autosave, GET /api/canvases/{id} returned 5 nodes and 4 connections with the expected mapped IDs. Reload rendered the same 5 nodes and 4 links.
classicPage.altUndo: A second two-node Alt copy increased nodes 5 to 7; native Control+Z once returned to 5. The saved canvas remained at 5 nodes and 4 links.

groupPage.seed: Self-made 2-prompt group plus one generator and one link, four nodes total.
groupPage.altShiftClick: The visible page added four nodes, including both group members; node count 4 to 8 and links 1 to 2.
groupPage.diskReadback: Copied group items reference the two copied prompts and the new link joins the copied group to the copied generator. Reload rendered 8 nodes, 2 links, and two groups each reporting 2 prompts.
groupPage.drag: A separate native drag of the selected copied group moved it, both copied prompts, and the selected copied generator together; the original group and nodes stayed in place.
groupPage.visibleReview: The isolated fixture was then laid out as two separate pairs at 50% viewport scale to make the before/after groups easy to compare. The page remains open in the in-app browser.

validation: The real startNodeDrag handler in tests/canvas_alt_group_copy.test.cjs failed before the fix and passed 3/3 after it.
Both visible canvas pages were used and reloaded; no generation button was clicked.
node --check static/js/canvas.js and git diff --check passed.
limits: The browser tool applies Alt or Alt+Shift to the initial click and performs the pointer drag separately, so a continuous held-modifier drag is not claimed. Native Ctrl+C/V remains blocked by the in-app browser virtual clipboard.
